says: Under a nurse's laser series for hyperpigmentation on Black skin, commenters defend that she is evening the skin tone, not lightening it, and ask whether it hurts and whether it works on lighter skin. Under a body-routine video, viewers joke about the cost and ask whether kojic soap can be an everyday body wash. The run-1 questions repeat the same worry: “how is this on brown skin that is prone to hyperpigmetation?”, “Effective on lighter skin as well?” (461 likes), and two separate askers wanting to know if a treatment works for melasma. One of the most-watched videos here (598×) is just a mother asking strangers for help with pregnancy melasma her doctor said would fade.
